articles.summary: Sails ship with an elegant logger called captains-log. In this article we will see how to modify your logs prefix with the prefixTheme option.
articles.title: Modifying Sails log prefix with prefix themes

articles.summary: The sails global gives you access to the running Sails application instance and the properties and methods it exposes. In this article we will see how we can disable it and other ways to access the running Sails application instance.
articles.title: Disabling the sails global
